This exclusion is controlled by adding the #DONT_CORR#  tag to the beginning of the rule's
description.
You can exclude an analytics rule from correlation using a toggle in the analytics rule wizard.
1. Go to the Microsoft Defender portal
and sign in.
2. Navigate to the Analytics rule wizard.
3. In the General tab of the rule wizard, enter and name and description.
4. In the Set rule logic tab, configure the rule logic as needed.
5. In the Incident settings tab, make sure the Enable correlation toggle is set to Disabled.
6. Set the toggle to On to exclude the rule from correlation.
When you exclude a rule using the UI toggle, the #DONT_CORR#  tag is automatically added to
the beginning of the rule's description. The analytics rules view now includes a column for
correlation state so you can easily see which rules are excluded as well as filter the list to see
rules in a specific state.
